comment: This new error returns the raw `path` to the client. CLAUDE.md #129/#190 require client-facing error messages to use `getRelativePath()` instead of leaking absolute filesystem paths. Route `path` through `getRelativePath()` here (and in the sibling `File not found` message) before building the error.
doubt: `path` is supplied by the same client, so echoing it back may not be an actual disclosure.
